stdout:
usage: provenant reap [-h] [--tree] [--grace S] [--started-before TIME]
                      pids [pids ...]

Stop explicit PIDs: TERM, then KILL after the grace period.

positional arguments:
  pids                  numeric PIDs; patterns and groups are refused

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tree                also stop descendants
  --grace S             seconds between TERM and KILL (default 5)
  --started-before TIME
                        refuse a PID whose process started after this epoch or
                        ISO time
